table.name: cmi_cross_references
table.summary: A lookup table mapping master customer IDs to specific source system codes, likely used to categorize customers or transactions by their origin system (e.g., Rent, Parking, Benefits).

cmi_cross_ref_id.name: cmi_cross_ref_id
cmi_cross_ref_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each cross-reference record within the table.

source_system_code.name: source_system_code
source_system_code.meaning: A code representing the specific business domain or system associated with the customer (e.g., Rent, Parking, Benefits).

table.name: customer_master_index
table.summary: A master index table linking unique customer identifiers to their associated company or organization names.

master_customer_id.name: master_customer_id
master_customer_id.meaning: A unique numeric identifier for a specific customer record within the system.

cmi_details.name: cmi_details
cmi_details.meaning: The name of the organization, firm, or legal entity associated with the customer.

table.name: electoral_register
table.summary: A table linking electoral registration records to a cross-reference system, likely containing unique identifiers for both the register and an external or internal mapping system.

electoral_register_id.name: electoral_register_id
electoral_register_id.meaning: The unique primary identifier for a specific entry in the electoral register.

cmi_cross_ref_id.name: cmi_cross_ref_id
cmi_cross_ref_id.meaning: A foreign key or reference ID linking the electoral record to a CMI (likely a specific departmental or external system) cross-reference table.

table.name: rent_arrears
table.summary: A table recording council tax arrears linked to a cross-reference system, likely used for debt management or billing reconciliation.

council_tax_id.name: council_tax_id
council_tax_id.meaning: Unique identifier for a specific council tax account or property.

cmi_cross_ref_id.name: cmi_cross_ref_id
cmi_cross_ref_id.meaning: Foreign key linking this record to an external system (likely CMI - Customer Management Interface) for cross-referencing data.

table.name: benefits_overpayments
table.summary: Records tracking overpayments associated with specific council tax accounts and cross-reference identifiers.

council_tax_id.name: council_tax_id
council_tax_id.meaning: Unique identifier for a council tax account or household.

cmi_cross_ref_id.name: cmi_cross_ref_id
cmi_cross_ref_id.meaning: Cross-reference identifier linking this record to a CMI (Central Management Information) system or related dataset.
